name: Theobroma Bakery and Cake Shop - Kalyan, Thane
description: Theobroma translates to 'Food of the Gods' in Greek, fit for our indulgent and exclusive range of products. Our offerings include gooey fudgy brownies, indulgent cakes, rich chocolates, decadent desserts, freshly baked breads, viennoiserie, wholesome savouries and fresh beverages, along with festive and seasonal products . Theobroma is now a pan-India patisserie chain with presence in Mumbai, Pune, Delhi NCR and Hyderabad. We believe in spreading happiness by serving smiles on a plate and hope to continue doing so as we open patisseries across the country. Our Kalyan outlet is open from 8 am to midnight for dine-in, delivery and takeaway. You can get your hands on freshly baked 'Food of the Gods' every day at our Kalyan outlet.

featured_reviews.review_text: Extremely disappointed. The Mango Tres Leches and Mousse Jar were both dry, sour, and tasted stale. This is nowhere close to the quality Theobroma is known for. Definitely not worth the money, and I won't be ordering these again.

featured_reviews.name: Shloka Hajare
featured_reviews.review_text:
Ambience: The shop has a mellow, peaceful vibe with great colour coordination. The staff is very helpful with suggestions and they help you try out new products in line.

Food: A great variety of pastries, brownies, biscotti, tea cakes and puffs. Their Tiramisu is mostly creme based, would prefer a bit more cake in it. The chocolate mousse seems water based. The menu is a bit on tue ‘costly’ end.

Recommendations: Their cupcakes (especially the chocolate one) are wonderful. Their Chocoholic pastry/cake is a must-try if you like creamy, chocolatey textures. The new introduction of Butterscotch and Milk Chocolate cake is a wonderful balance of sweet with a crunch. And their Strawberry Custard cake has a very different flavour composition of white chocolate balanced with strawberry compote and the sponge has a dense texture.

featured_reviews.review_text:

On top of that, the instructions I gave were not followed. I had asked for a handwritten message saying "Happy Birthday Mummy" and candles, but neither was included. This was meant to be a special occasion, but it was ruined.

Very unhappy with the service.

Monginis Cake Shop is a reliable and popular choice for everyday treats and special occasion cakes.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Fresco Bakery & Cake Shop is a delightful destination for anyone who loves fresh, high-quality baked goods and a cozy café experience. Located in a convenient spot, this bakery offers a wide variety of cakes, pastries, and other baked treats that cater to different tastes and preferences.

One of the standout features of Fresco is its diverse selection. From classic cakes to gourmet pastries like croissants, every item is freshly prepared and full of flavor. They also serve a range of savory options, including burgers, making it a great place for both sweet and savory cravings. Their coffee pairs perfectly with the baked items, creating a satisfying experience whether you're stopping by for breakfast or an evening snack.

Among the many treats, the choco lava cake stood out the most. Priced at just ₹80, it had a rich, gooey texture with a perfect balance of sweetness. It was neither overly sugary nor bland—just the right mix to please any chocolate lover.

Beyond the food, the ambiance at Fresco is warm and inviting. The interiors are well-designed, offering a comfortable space to relax, whether you’re catching up with friends or enjoying some quiet time. The staff is courteous and attentive, enhancing the overall experience with their friendly service.

Cake Presentation: 5 /5
